medium: hand-authored HTML, captured in browser. No image generation on this machine, so the comp is the real composition rather than a render of one.
prompt: Review queue as a tag wall with an evidence bench. Three regions: 52px icon rail, 268px tag wall listing every held item as a thin row with a coloured status edge, short description and confidence, grouped by work front; then the evidence pane for the selected item, which carries the spoken quote at heading scale, why it is held, the seven scoring signals as labelled bars, ranked alternatives with their scores, and a persistent action bar at the foot. Live call and board totals sit in a right column inside the evidence pane.
varies: Evidence depth over throughput. Fewer items visible, far more reason per decision, and the seven signals become readable rather than a single number.
